name: Turbotic
summary: Enterprise automation orchestration. Manage your entire ecosystem of RPA, AI, and scripts from a single control tower.
best_for: teams that want an AI-assisted way to discover, document and run automations without deep RPA expertise
skip_if: you need a huge, battle-tested integration ecosystem right now — an established platform has more connectors and community
honest_knock: It's a newer, enterprise-leaning automation platform, so it's less proven with a smaller community than the big names — and the credit-per-execution model means heavy volume needs cost-checking. Verify it integrates with your actual stack first.

pricing.entry_price_terms: AI Assistant, per seat… · per seat per month as published
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02, read on their own product page) The Turbotic AI Assistant is $25 per seat per month and includes 1,500 credits a month, with additional credits bought as needed. The broader orchestration platform is not priced publicly at all: turbotic.com/pricing now redirects to the site's own demo-booking form, with no figures on it, so everything above the assistant seat is quoted after a sales conversation. No free plan is mentioned.

open_questions.question: Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?
